compliance.dltNote: TRAI TCCCPR 2018: bulk commercial SMS in India needs DLT registration (Principal Entity ID, 6-character header with -P/-S/-T/-G category suffix, registered content template, consent template) and a declared telemarketer traceability chain. Unregistered bulk SMS is blocked by operators. No DLT registration status is claimed for this client. The Sarpanch SMS leg uses manual 1-to-1 messages from Amit own phone number via Google Messages for web, not a bulk gateway. Even so, keep volume human, personalise every message, message only people who were pitched or asked, honour opt-outs at once, and move to a DLT-registered bulk route if volume grows.

engagement.nonBuyerRule: Even if a lead does not look like a buyer, still ask questions, engage them, and try to convert. Never drop a non-obvious lead without engaging first.
engagement.rule: Ask qualifying questions first, pitch second. Questions turn a cold lead into a warm one.
